item.title: Vladimir Putin welcomed children of special military operation heroes into the Kremlin for tea
item.description: Vladimir Putin welcomed children of special military operation heroes into the Kremlin for tea On National Unity Day, the President took part in several official events, including a ceremony to lay flowers at the monument to Kuzma Minin and Dmitry Pozharsky in Red Square. The ceremony was attended by representatives of religious denominations and members of non-governmental and youth organisations, but the Russian leader also spoke with children of special military operation heroes who were in Red Square. According to Presidential Press Secretary Dmitry Peskov, Vladimir Putin invited children whose fathers died as heroes while serving in the special military operation to a tea party at the Kremlin. State Secretary — Deputy Minister of Defence and Chair of the Defenders of the Fatherland Foundation Anna Tsivileva attended the event as well.

The ceremony was attended by representatives of religious denominations and members of non-governmental and youth organisations, but the Russian leader also spoke with children of special military operation heroes who were in Red Square.
According to Presidential Press Secretary Dmitry Peskov, Vladimir Putin invited children whose fathers died as heroes while serving in the special military operation to a tea party at the Kremlin.
State Secretary — Deputy Minister of Defence and Chair of the Defenders of the Fatherland Foundation Anna Tsivileva attended the event as well.

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, losses were inflicted on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Berezhnoye, Garbuzovka, Doroshenkovo, and Kolodeznoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Sumy region,
Russian troops engaged formations of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Markovka, Nikolskoye, Putivl, and Spasskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 195 troops, 31 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
⏩
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade near Monachinovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region), Bogorodichnoye, Krymki, and Raygorodok of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, 14 motor vehicles, and four electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian troops hit formations of three mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Druzhkovka, Kondratovka, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Starodubovka, and Yasnogorka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU lost more than 180 troops and 31 motor vehicles.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Verovka, Veselaya Gora, Kamenka, Krivorozhye, Roganskoye, and Yakovlevka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 335 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.

item.description: Russia–Kazakhstan military cooperation dynamically develops — Andrei Belousov Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov held a meeting with Minister of Defence of the Republic of Kazakhstan Aidos Myrzakhmetov as part of a working visit to Kazakhstan. 💬 During the meeting, the heads of defence departments of Russia and Kazakhstan discussed topical issues of bilateral military cooperation. 'The Republic of Kazakhstan is our time-tested friend, good neighbour, and a CSTO ally. Russian-Kazakhstan military cooperation is dynamically developing. This is confirmed by the increase in the number of events, the emergence of new directions and fields of interaction,' the Russian Defence Minister said. ❗️ The Russian Defence Minister noted that in the course of bilateral military cooperation, particular attention is paid to operational and combat training of troops. 'I would like to express my gratitude for the assistance in resolving issues related to the functioning of the Russian training grounds. This makes it possible to develop weapons to ensure the security of our countries,' Andrei Belousov added. ➡️ The Russian Defence Minister noted that a key priority of interaction is military-technical cooperation. Russia–Kazakhstan military cooperation dynamically develops — Andrei Belousov
Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov held a meeting with Minister of Defence of the Republic of Kazakhstan Aidos Myrzakhmetov as part of a working visit to Kazakhstan.
💬
During the meeting, the heads of defence departments of Russia and Kazakhstan
discussed topical issues of bilateral military cooperation.
'The Republic of Kazakhstan is our time-tested friend, good neighbour, and a CSTO ally. Russian-Kazakhstan military cooperation is dynamically developing. This is confirmed by the increase in the number of events, the emergence of new directions and fields of interaction,' the Russian Defence Minister said.
❗️
The Russian Defence Minister noted that in the course of bilateral military cooperation,
particular attention is paid to operational and combat training of troops. 'Military personnel training is carried out and we regularly hold joint consultations on a wide range of military activities,'
the Russian Defence Minister stated.
'I would like to express my gratitude for the assistance in resolving issues related to the functioning of the Russian training grounds. This makes it possible to develop weapons to ensure the security of our countries,' Andrei Belousov added.
➡️
The Russian Defence Minister noted that
a key priority of interaction is military-technical cooperation.
He also stressed that the
parties regularly hold talks on the coordination of defence policy.
🤝
In turn,
Aidos Myrzakhmetov stated that the Ministry of Defence of Kazakhstan gives particular importance to the development of relations with the Russian military department.
He congratulated the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation and the Russian delegation on the holiday of the Day of National Unity.
✅
At the end of the meeting,
the plan for bilateral cooperation
between the Russian and Kazakhstan defence ministries for 2027
was approved.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
